body:
Maria Ops: inbound EU drop (18 A100s). Vendor emailed: 2 units failed vendor QC and marked DOA. AWB: EUX-452211. Can we partial-release the healthy units and get express replacements? @Jordan please confirm SLA.
Jordan SCM: Contract replacement window = 5 business days. Vendor offering 48h express for +€3,800. Need quick approval or pull from loaner pool. How bad is the customer impact?
Omar (BlueShip): BlueShip here  AWB EUX-452211 covers 16 ship-ready + 2 DOA. Flagged serials A100-E210, A100-E211. We can dispatch replacements tomorrow with express as soon as we get payment OK. RMA label RX-EUX4522 included.
Priya Crossdock: crossdock note: please tag DOA units `HOLD-DOA` and `QC-VERIFY`. If we don't, they'll get packed into the same pallet. Also vendor changed consignee contact on the replacement AWB  need confirmation to avoid customs hold.
Maria Ops: propose: partial release 16 -> staging-FRA, hold 2 at crossdock. We have a small canary needing 3 A100s, so loaner pool check first. @Jordan can you check loaners?
Jordan SCM: loaner pool: 2 A100 available in FRA region already allocated to a training job until EOD. Transit from AMS is 20h. Not acceptable for canary. Recommend express.
finance-bot: finance-bot: express cost (€3,800) < estimated SLA credit exposure. Approve up to €4,000 for express replacements. Charge code: INFRA-GPU-EU. Please attach vendor invoice when posted.
Omar (BlueShip): thanks  scheduling express now. Expected replacement AWB post at ts 1789993720, ETA depot 36-48h. We'll include prepaid RMA RX-EUX4522 for returns.
Priya Crossdock: applying hold tags and moving 16 units to `staging-fra-ready`. Manifest snippet: 
```
unit,serial,location,status
A100,A100-E101,staging-fra,ready
A100,A100-E102,staging-fra,ready
...
A100,A100-E210,crossdock-fra,hold-doa
A100,A100-E211,crossdock-fra,hold-doa
```
Maria Ops: notified SRE to delay canary by 6h and mark the two customers as at-risk. Closing thread unless vendor misses ETA or customs contact mismatch. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
